name: smwmusic-steel-ball-run-jojo-s-bizarre-adventure-dance-with-steel-ball-run-star-mix
title: Steel Ball Run: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure - Dance with STEEL BALL RUN (Star-mix)
description:
Did a short star-mix of Dance with STEEL BALL RUN from Steel Ball Run: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure because I haven't done anything Jojo related in a while, and I thought I'd shit this one out before I get to doing real stuff with the series again.

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. C (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. B Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
ㅤ3. C# Minor (Custom Pitch 2)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Skips the Intro (INTRO Skipped)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. Enables the Intro (INTRO Enabled)
